definition: The Monday party at DC10 in Ibiza, created in 1999 by Antonio Carbonaro and Andrea Pelino as a free Monday-morning after-party.
The club on Ibiza's Carretera de Salinas where CircoLoco runs, opened in the 1990s as a bar licensed for 80 people; it holds 1,500 today.
A record label co-owned by CircoLoco and Rockstar Games, announced May 24, 2021.
The company RockstarINTEL and the fan wiki name as owner of the CircoLoco Records trade name; no company filing confirming it has been published.
The label's catalog prefix: CLR on records, retailers and Discogs; CRL in many RockstarINTEL headlines and on the GTA wiki. Same series.
The label's 20-track debut compilation, issued as Blue, Green, Violet and Black EPs in June 2021 and as an album on July 9, 2021.
A GTA Online radio-wheel slot, added with Los Santos Tuners on July 20, 2021, that plays collected Media Sticks.
A collectible USB stick in GTA Online's world that unlocks a mix or EP on the Media Player.
Seth Troxler's bonus mix built from the Monday Dreamin' stems, unlocked by collecting all four EP sticks. Rockstar says it reworks all 20 tracks; the fan wiki lists 16.
Artists and repertoire: finding artists and choosing which records a label releases. At CircoLoco Records, it sits with the CircoLoco side.
CircoLoco's 20th-year slogan, which Antonio Carbonaro turned into a separate platform.
The German collective showcased on CLR 005, the 2023 various-artists record Anyway.
